symptom: File Uploader `allowedfileformat` left at the default `configMode: 'simple'` passes `mxcli check` and exec, then `mx check` reports CE0463 "The definition of this widget has changed" on the uploader; `configMode: 'advanced'` on every item avoids it
cause: The editorConfig hides an item's `typeFormatDescription` (plus mimeType/extensions) per ITEM via `hideNestedPropertiesIn(..., "allowedFileFormats", index, [...])` while that item's configMode is "simple". The extractor lifted the rule (ListPropertyKey allowedFileFormats, item-scoped condition), but `ApplyVisibilityRules` only walked top-level properties, so the hidden required TextTemplate kept the populated ClientTemplate the item builder fills it with (#891). Studio Pro wants null there (#574 one level down)
insight: Without the real .mpk, a faithful one can be built: sparse-clone mendix/web-widgets `packages/pluggableWidgets/file-uploader-web`, bundle `src/*.editorConfig.ts` with bun (alias `@mendix/pluggable-widgets-tools` to the npm package's `dist/utils/PageEditorUtils.js`), terser it, and rewrite bun's `module.exports=__toCommonJS(...)` to plain `exports.getProperties=...` — with `module.exports` mxbuild silently ignores the editorConfig (CE0642 'Associated images is required' was the tell: hidden properties were being required-checked). `mx update-widgets` on a copy then diffed by PropertyKey isolated the single slot (`typeFormatDescription.TextTemplate` → null). The same fix also cleared the long-standing CE0463 on doctype-tests/32 Accordion `acc2` (groups with HeaderRenderMode custom hide the required `headerText`) — a nested-rule class, so check every widget with object-list TextTemplate rules (`mxcli widget describe` lists them) before and after; DataGrid columns' nested rules agree with emptyClientTemplateRules so 31 stays at 0. Maps map1/map2 CE0463 in fixture 32 are a separate, still-open cause
